summary: Iteration 49: Complete testing of Admin Cart Management feature (Корзины). Backend: 18/18 tests passed. Frontend: All features working correctly including cart list, expand/collapse, product details, quantity controls, price editing with inline input, add product modal with search, clear cart, and search filtering.
seed_data_creation: Used existing test carts in database
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin Cart Management feature is fully operational. Key features verified: 1) GET /api/admin/carts returns all non-empty carts with user info, product details, individual prices, and totals. 2) GET /api/admin/carts/{user_id} returns specific user cart with product enrichment. 3) POST /api/admin/carts/{user_id}/add adds product to cart (increases quantity if exists). 4) PUT /api/admin/carts/{user_id}/item/{product_id} updates quantity (enforces min 1) and/or sets individual price. 5) DELETE /api/admin/carts/{user_id}/item/{product_id} removes item and deactivates individual price. 6) DELETE /api/admin/carts/{user_id} clears entire cart. 7) Frontend shows expandable cart cards with user info, product images, article, manufacturer. 8) Price clicking shows inline input with confirm/cancel. 9) Quantity +/- buttons work (minus disabled at 1). 10) 'Добавить товар' opens modal with product search (needs 2+ chars). 11) 'Очистить корзину' clears cart with confirmation. 12) Search bar filters carts by user name, email, or product name. 13) 'Корзины' link visible in admin header between Заказы and Чаты.
